info.title: TigerConnect
info.description: TigerConnect is a clinical communication and collaboration platform used by healthcare organizations for secure, HIPAA-compliant messaging between care team members, patients, and connected systems. Authentication: HTTP Basic Auth.

post.description: This endpoint lets users generate or update users.

unique_id.description: The user's unique identifier. If there's already a user with this unique_id in the caller's organization, it will be updated. If there's a user with the same unique_id but it doesn't belong to the caller's organization, an error will be returned. And, if there's no users with that unique_id, the user will be created.

emails.description: A list of the user's email addresses

phones.description: A list of the user's phone numbers

display_name.description: The user's display name (if not provided it's built using first_name and/or last_name)

distinguished_name.description: The user's unique identifier used in conjunction with optional header TT-X-Organization-Key for external authentication

get.description: This endpoint retrieves user information associated with the user addressed by [Addressing Users and Groups](https://developer.tigertext.com/docs/messaging-users-and-groups), if found. members.description: list of the new members on the group encoded using address encoding (users already in the group are ignored). When sending a Json object, you can send the list directly instead of an object with the members property. There is a maximum group size limit. Default for public group is 5000 members. Default for private group is 100 members. Both are configurable.

post.description: As a customer, you can have many integration id's for an Organization. This endpoint will give you a list of all the different integrations you have for your Organization.

To interact with the scheduler and upload or add "shift" records, you will first need access to your Organization key.  An Admin user in the Organization can retrieve the key in the Settings/Organization section of the TigerText website.

You will use this Organization key in the creation of the Integration Id.  The integration id is used throughout the scheduler API.  
The integration id is unique to the organization and partner key that TigerText has created for you.
You will need your organization token to

The Integration Id is needed for all the `scheduler/mappings/*` API and `schedule/webhook/*` API
